entities.name: customer seated at the small table under the stall's west eave (low confidence)
entities.what: Possibly a man in a hood or broad cap seated at a small table just inside the stall's west end post, facing east toward the standing man beside him; only a head-sized oval outline and the table in front of it are readable. A customer at the village tea stall.
entities.vis: part: body behind the small table S1.prop.stall_table_small_29285; faint
entities.note: BOTH READINGS: an oval outline u 29269-29289, v 546-580 (about 34 px tall, half again F2's head) right west of the stall post at u ~29292, with table strokes under it at v ~597-606. It reads as a head in a hood or a broad cap (the restyle paints a man in grey here with a basket at his waist, head ~(29280, 547)), or as a round thing (a hat, a gourd or a sieve) hung on the post. Seated foot est where a seated figure's feet would rest behind the table (the seat is hidden). Read at zoom 2-3.5, colour-normalised crops.

entities.name: man standing under the stall's west eave
entities.what: A man in a long robe and a small cap or topknot standing under the thatched stall's west eave between two posts, face turned toward the viewer and a little west; a dark round bundle sits on his back or right shoulder. The stall keeper or a customer standing at the tables.
entities.vis: part: lower robe crossed by the willow S1.tree.willow_stall_c_29300's trunk
entities.note: Head u 29319-29340, v 549-571 (the clearest head at the stall); robe to v ~650; diagonal strokes across the robe (u 29305-29340, v 600-650) may be his legs if he sits on a hidden bench (then foot ~(29315, 650)); at 100 px tall he matches a standing adult here (the man at the post, v 1114, is 146 px). A dark rounded shape right of his head (u 29340-29354, v 554-577) is read as a bundle on his back, as the restyle paints it; it could be a third head behind him (not recorded as a figure). The setup's note says the restyle 'adds a standing man in red beside the seated customer': the red man it paints is this figure, whose head is plain on the scan, so he is kept.

entities.name: small table at the stall's west end
entities.what: A small low table just inside the stall's west end post, in front of the seated customer; only its top board and a leg or two show.
entities.vis: part: legs hidden by the customer and the post
entities.note: Top board u 29267-29303 at v ~597-606 (about 36 px long, SCALE CUE); legs down to about v 630-640 (est).

entities.name: long stall table (counter) along the open front
entities.what: A long table or counter on legs along the open front of the thatched stall, under the eave, with goods or a slatted screen standing on it behind; the stall's serving table.
entities.vis: part: the willow S1.tree.willow_stall_c_29300's trunk crosses its west half
entities.note: Top edge u 29370-29490 at v 598-602; corner legs at u 29370-29377 and 29483-29490 down to v 663-667, a bottom rail at v ~660-667 (u 29460-29490). Over it, from the eave (v ~540) to the top, vertical slats and dark wavy strokes (u 29437-29490, v 553-597): goods on the counter or the shed's lattice front (structures_w's if lattice). Its depth is not drawn (back corners est, 24 px). SCALE CUE: 116 px long, top 63 px above its feet. If structures_w records this as the shed's front, keep one.

entities.name: round shallow basket or tub on the ground in front of the stall
entities.what: A wide, shallow round basket (or a low tub or feeding trough) lying on the ground at the foot of the stall's counter, beside the lying water buffalo's head, with a short handle or pole running east from it.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Pale oval with an inner ring, u 29407-29452, v 650-676 (45 x 26 px, SCALE CUE); a line from its east rim to about (29480, 664) may be a handle, a pole or the buffalo's tether. The setup's 'something pale beside' the buffalo.

entities.name: pale upright board or hanging sign between the two stall willows (low confidence)
entities.what: A narrow pale upright board with a curled or hooked top between the two dark willow trunks west of the stall: a shop sign or banner hung from a branch, or a pale post of a lean-to between the trees.
entities.vis: part: between and partly behind the trunks of S1.tree.willow_stall_a_29178 and S1.tree.willow_stall_b_29262
entities.note: BOTH READINGS: pale strip u 29163-29180, v 445-530 with dark edges and a small loop at its top (v ~445-455); below v 530 it merges into the west trunk. The restyle paints a pale wooden post here running down to about v 560. Base est on the ground at the trunks' foot level. If it is a post of a lean-to roof, it is structures_w's (a duplicate is easy to drop).

entities.name: small bundle hung on the stall willow (low confidence)
entities.what: A small cluster of pale things (a bundle, a string of straw sandals or gourds) hung on the east side of the west stall willow's trunk at head height; or a small child standing behind the trunks.
entities.vis: part: against the trunks
entities.note: BOTH READINGS: small figure-like strokes u 29185-29212, v 545-583 (about 35 px tall) between the two trunks. The restyle paints a hanging bundle (white cloth and a stick) tied to the trunk. As a standing figure it would be about a third of an adult at this depth (a small child or a dog), which the strokes don't support (no head shape); recorded as a hung thing. Base est on the ground below it.

entities.name: water buffalo lying in front of the stall
entities.what: A big dark water buffalo lying on the ground in front of the stall with its legs folded under it, its head at the east end raised and turned toward the viewer, horns curving back; no tack. Resting while its owner is at the stall.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Body u 29353-29495, v 693-790 (142 px long, 97 px high: SCALE CUE), darkest on its flank; head u 29450-29503, v 677-717 with the horns' tips at about (29497, 702) and (29455, 680); the rump at the west end (u 29353-29373, v 723-787) with the hind legs tucked. fore/hind = the ground under the folded fore and hind legs (the body's bottom contour is v 777-790). ONE buffalo on the scan: the restyle's second lying animal (a dark head at u ~29290-29345, v 650-700) is the leaning trunk of S1.tree.willow_stall_c_29300, which runs from (29300, 742) up to (29400, 600).

entities.name: ox standing with its head lowered
entities.what: A pale brown ox (yellow cattle) standing in front of the stall's east end, facing the viewer and a little west, its head lowered as if grazing or resting; no tack or load.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Outline only (unshaded): back line v 603-609 from u 29506 to 29606; head down in the middle front, u 29540-29566, v 631-677; front legs at u 29517-29529 and 29549-29563 to v 723-729, hind legs at u 29563-29597 to v 694-703. SCALE CUE: body 100 px long, 120 px from back to front hooves. Facing read from the head between the forelegs; the restyle agrees.

entities.name: wheelbarrow tipped over on the ground
entities.what: A one-wheeled barrow (独轮车) set down tipped on its side on the open ground in front of the stall's east end: a long tapering trough-like body lying slantwise, its pointed handle end to the west, its spoked wheel upright at the east end. Empty.
entities.vis: full
entities.note: Body u 29666-29790, v 633-697; wheel rim u 29777-29807, v 658-694 (about 36 px across, centre (29792, 676): SCALE CUE); a curved frame over the wheel (u 29737-29795, v 635-650). front = under the wheel (the barrow's front end), rear = under the pointed west (handle) end. DEPTH DIRECTION (lying thing, not a ruled edge): (29672, 646) -> (29795, 694), slope +0.39. The wheel is drawn round (face on), so the barrow may be tipped forward onto its nose rather than flat on its side; the setup and the restyle read it as lying on its side.

entities.name: dark willow west of the stall (the west of the two)
entities.what: Willow with a thick dark trunk leaning up to the north-west from the ground west of the stall, forking at about v 440 into limbs with fans of long, straight, rising bare shoots (willow_fan; its heavy dark bole could also suit willow_burl). Leafless early-spring shoots. Its crown mingles with its neighbour's over the stall's west end.
entities.vis: part: crown overlapped by S1.tree.willow_stall_b_29262's
entities.note: Trunk foot u 29165-29200, v 616-636 (S2's t12 reads the trunk at u 29152-29180, v 600-632, base about (29166, 630): within 12 px); the trunk leans NW to a pale knobbed head at u 29049-29130, v 430-520. SEAM: base 128 px east of u 29050, crown on both sides: S1's.

entities.name: dark willow at the stall's west end (the east of the two)
entities.what: Willow with a massive dark knotty trunk rising nearly upright (leaning slightly west) at the stall's west end, branching at about v 440 into limbs with fans of long rising bare shoots (willow_fan, or willow_burl for the heavy bole). Leafless early spring.
entities.vis: part: crown overlapped by its neighbours'
entities.note: Trunk foot u 29236-29292, v 660-680; trunk u 29190-29280 from v 440 to 660. Crown extremes approximate (shared with S1.tree.willow_stall_a_29178 and S1.tree.willow_stall_c_29300). A pale hung thing on its west side is S1.prop.hanging_bundle_29198.

entities.name: leaning willow through the stall's front
entities.what: Willow whose trunk rises from the ground just west of the lying buffalo and leans steeply north-east across the stall's open front, then turns up to fork above the thatched roof into limbs with fans of rising bare shoots over the stall's west half (willow_fan). Leafless early spring.
entities.vis: part: trunk passes behind the stall counter and the standing man
entities.note: Trunk read as one dark band from its foot (u 29288-29312, v 727-748) up NE to (29347, 663), (29400, 610), then up-left to the fork at about (29373, 490) above the eave. The restyle paints its lower part as the head of a second lying buffalo (u ~29290-29345, v 650-700): on the scan it is continuous with the trunk above. Its foot reads about 65 px south of the other two willows', so it stands in front of the stall line. Crown u 29280-29610, v 240-530; the east fans (u 29440-29610) might belong to a tree whose trunk is hidden behind the roof (none seen).

entities.name: far tree with a tall straight trunk at the top

entities.vis: part: crown cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: Trunk u 29413-29440 (about 25 px thick) from the top edge to a flared foot at u 29408-29435, v 150-175. The restyle paints it as a gnarled willow at (29400-29430, base ~190). entities.name: far small figure on the terrace (west of the far willow), low confidence

entities.vis: faded

entities.vis: faded

entities.name: man with a hooked stick on his shoulder, gesturing west
entities.what: A man in a pale robe and a small cap, half hidden in the big willow's shoots, leaning forward toward the west with his left arm stretched out (calling or pointing), a long stick with a small hooked or forked head (a hoe or rake?) over his right shoulder. A farmer or villager.
entities.vis: part: below the waist hidden by S1.tree.willow_burl_29090's shoots
entities.note: Head u 29190-29217, v 955-980; hand at about (29167, 1010); the stick's head at (29233-29243, 933-960). Body visible to v ~1040, then the willow's whips cover it: foot est from the adults here (the man at the post is 146 px tall, foot v 1114). He faces west toward the stall; could also be calling a warning of the runaway horse (惊马闯市), but nothing ties him to it.

entities.name: great pollarded willow at the bottom-left corner (seam)
entities.what: Huge old pollarded willow at the silk's bottom edge: a massive dark, knotted bole with buttress roots rising to a broad clubbed pollard head at about v 1450-1560, from which a fountain of long, straight bare whips springs up and out over the lower-left corner, the east whips reaching the vegetable field (willow_burl). Leafless early spring.
entities.vis: part: foot cut by the silk's bottom edge (v ~1782)
entities.note: SEAM (u 29050): at the silk's bottom edge (v ~1782) the bole spans u ~28960-29250 (west outline from (28948, 1636) to (28975, 1782); roots east at u 29080-29250, a pale gap between roots at u 29125-29180, v 1745-1780). Its middle reads u ~29090 (my reading 29095, S2's t12 29070 ± 20): 20-45 px east of the seam, so S1's; S2's t12 did not record it and gives the same base est. Pollard head u 28945-29182, v 1436-1564; a dark knot at u 28944-29011, v 1497-1563. The trunk leans up and west: a huge limb with a knobbed head (u 28720-28880, v 1283-1450, S2 t12) reaches west over S2's bottom boat, and a leader from it rises to fans of shoots at u 28720-29120, v 750-970 (the top, about (28850, 755)). Whips reach west to u ~28585 (v 800-1000) and east to u ~29610 (v 1400-1620), where they hide the feet of the walker S1.fig.man_with_stick_29205 and of the grove's two west trees. MERGE (seam): S1's by its base (S2 t12 reads the base at (29070, 1785) and did not record it); its crown runs west over S2 to u ~28585 and its knobbed limb (28720-28880, v 1283-1450) reaches over S2.veh.boat_bottom_28395.

entities.name: child standing on the open ground west of the post (惊马闯市)

entities.vis: full
entities.note: CHILD: 64 px tall against the man at the post's 146 px (0.44) and the walker's ~140 px, at nearly the same foot v. Head u 29667-29683, v 1000-1012; a hand out east at about (29690, 1045). Facing is uncertain (the restyle paints the child in red, walking west and looking back).

entities.name: man at the post reaching out to the child (the old man of 惊马闯市)
entities.what: A man with a topknot, leaning his body against the bar of a tall post and stretching his right arm far out to the west toward the child, as if calling it to him: read as the old man calling a child out of the runaway horse's way. Dressed in a robe; something small (a bundle, a jar or his left hand) at his chest.
entities.vis: part: legs faint; partly behind S1.prop.post_crossbar_29862's bar

The setup's 'figures carrying a pole' at u 29800-29880 are this man and the post. The restyle paints him in grey-blue, leaning on the bar, arm out. Age can't be read (the scholarship calls him old). SECOND PASS (west): read at zoom 3-4 (colour, grey, high-pass): no second figure. The small pointed shape (u 29815-29832, v 1027-1053) has no face, and no second head, arms or feet go with it: it is his left sleeve and hand (or a small gourd or bottle held at his chest, the restyle's hanging sleeve). The dark mass (u 29827-29857, v 1043-1060) lies on the bar's west side, between him and the post: his forearm laid on the bar as he leans. The strokes at v 1080-1117 (u 29800-29837) continue his robe down to his legs, matching his 146 px height.

entities.name: tall post with a forked top and a crossbar (hitching post or well upright)

entities.name: the village tea and food stall and the animals resting in front
entities.what: The thatched village stall at the edge of the market: a man stands under its west eave by a small table where a customer may sit, a long counter runs along its open front with a round basket at its foot, and in front of it a water buffalo lies and an ox stands with its head down, with a wheelbarrow tipped over to the east: travellers and their animals resting.
entities.vis: full
entities.src: sections.md §2: the village tea and food stalls at the edge of the market
entities.note: The stall shed itself (thatched roof u ~29250-29825, front eave v ~540-550, posts at u ~29292, 29365, 29485) is structures_w's. No herder is painted with the animals; their owners are presumably the people at the stall.
